articles.title: Losing the Wrong Kind of Fat Can Actually Cause Diabetes
articles.summary: Scientists found that losing healthy fat can trigger diabetes. In a rare disease, fat cells stop working, causing inflammation and energy problems. This shows fat isn't just storage—it's a vital organ that keeps your metabolism running.

articles.title: The Brain's Secret Switch: Why Some People Escape Alzheimer's
articles.summary: Scientists found a hidden tipping point in the brain that may decide who gets Alzheimer's. Some people have brain plaques but stay sharp because their immune cells act differently. Even 100-year-olds can resist dementia by using a special protective response.

articles.title: Firefighters Use Fire to Save Giant Sequoias—And It Works!
articles.summary: Giant sequoias, some as heavy as 15 blue whales, were dying in huge wildfires. But a study found that trees in areas with prescribed burns were four times more likely to survive. Setting small, controlled fires clears out fuel and protects these ancient giants.
